decisions.reason: As a distant, highly specialized line that was only lightly presented on the website, submarine interior lighting looks like a weaker option whose uncertain upside may no longer justify continued attention versus nearer-core projects.

The medical examination light builds on the firm’s lighting capabilities, was given a dedicated page, and in a growing industry an expanding R&D-active firm would usually keep this adjacent option alive while market potential becomes clearer.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm’s industrial customer base and engineering strengths very well, and as a multi-model line they offer strong strategic fit and option value with relatively low reason to exit quickly.

The designer task light is close to the existing offer and even described as a relaunch of a popular product, so despite being less central than heavy-duty professional lines it is still more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
